purpose: How the twice-daily refresh designs or redesigns a use case's solution page. The app is 100% data-driven: a design is one JSON document stored in Customers-704f56 rows (DocKind = solution, DocRef = use case id). The app shows the route-specific layout from blueprint.kind and only renders what the JSON holds.

routeRules.m365: Often only prompts: 1-3 reusable Copilot prompts in the Office app the user already uses, shared via Prompt Gallery; effort in hours; run cost included in the Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. No agent, no flow, no architecture chapter.
routeRules.cowork: One analyst's multi-step task: a task brief for Copilot Cowork across mail, files, Teams and Power BI; effort in hours or days; no build project.
routeRules.studio: A shared Copilot Studio agent: agent name, instructions, topics, tools/actions and connectors, knowledge, automations (agent flows / Power Automate) with trigger and steps, channels, Copilot Credits estimate per conversation from the official credit rates; architecture chapter allowed.
routeRules.fabric: A data product: sources, lakehouse/semantic model, Fabric data agent and alerts; capacity cost; architecture chapter allowed.
routeRules.foundry: Pro-code: model choice, pipeline, evaluation, hosting, MLOps; Azure consumption; architecture and delivery plan chapters.
routeRules.noai: Rules and automation (Power Automate, process mining, reporting); no AI cost. If the customer already chose a non-Microsoft platform for it, keep that choice and add kit.platform as a 'What if Microsoft?' scenario, never replace it.
routeRules.codeapp: The need is an application: a Power Apps code app with screens, data model, flows; explain why a code app rather than a canvas or model-driven app.
routeRules.unknown: Not enough information: list what is still needed and the questions to ask; no design.

howTo: Read the exemplar design of the TARGET kind (exemplarRef above) and copy its exact JSON structure (same keys, same nesting, same value types); replace every value with content for this use case. Never copy the exemplar's facts.

Ground product facts in Microsoft Learn (full URLs in sources / blueprint links). Never invent customer figures, people or dates; write 'To confirm' or 'Not stated'. Money in $ only; hours stay hours.

Set route to the use case's Classification label, blueprint.kind to the matching kind, theme to one of lab, plant, finance, procurement, customer, people, compliance, market, sustainability, communication, logistics, engineering.

Keep use-case-specific chapters (hackathon, pathway) only when they still apply to the new route; then add any customer-specific wording as data fields (hackathon.voiceTitle, voiceSource, demoNote; pathway.party), never assume the app writes it.
Validate: the JSON parses, every key of the exemplar exists, arrays are non-empty where the exemplar's are.
exemplars: Each kind's exemplarRef is the DocRef (use case id) of one Current design of that kind in THIS instance. A new instance starts with none: until a kind has an exemplar, build the design from topLevelKeys, blueprintKeys and kitKeys and the types in app/src/lib/solutions.ts, then set exemplarRef to the first design of that kind the owner accepts.
